blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY- A woman died from a fall from a building along Kisad Road behind Burnham Park on Sunday, prompting an investigation by the Baguio City Police Office (BCPO). An initial report said the incident occurred shortly after 8 a.m. Police Station 5 later conducted a follow-up investigation and was able to identify the deceased
